sampling_plan.purpose: Confirm source structure and progression from fundamentals through shadow construction.
Identify D'Amelio's teaching premise and intended use of principles rather than dogmatic rules.
Compare diminution, foreshortening, convergence, and overlap with existing figure-specific canon.
Test vanishing-point and eye-level material against known capability gaps.
Inspect the cube as a practical carrier for convergence and object orientation.
Check whether shade/shadow construction introduces a distinct unrepresented capability.
Evaluate the whole book as the first unit in a multi-book perspective curriculum, using the named repo as golden truth.

observations.summary: The book is a cumulative perspective course: basic depth cues lead to view theory, eye level/vanishing points, cube construction, distortion control, measurement, inclined planes, round solids, and cast shadows.
The method explicitly aims to explain why perspective appearances occur and warns against memorized rules without causes.
Overlap and foreshortening substantially reinforce existing figure-specific cards, but D'Amelio generalizes them from body forms to arbitrary objects and scenes.
Eye level, horizontal vanishing line, direction-specific vanishing points, and their relation to looking up/down are major capabilities absent from the frozen perspective canon.
The cube sequence provides a general object-construction and convergence-selection method rather than merely another figure foreshortening example.
The final chapter adds constructive parallel-sun and local-point-source cast-shadow projection, which the baseline does not cover.

Whole-book routing is appropriate because the source is compact, internally cumulative, and intended to become the first reconciled layer of a larger perspective study rather than a chapter-by-chapter commit stream.

rationale: The baseline contains useful figure foreshortening and overlap knowledge but is explicitly silent on the general perspective field D'Amelio teaches. The sampled gaps are foundational enough to justify complete Gate 2 coverage and a deep PASS of the earned deltas.
